description:
Evaluates a caller-supplied symbolic alpha formula causally with a no-lookahead guard.

Reports cross-sectional Spearman rank IC, Newey-West HAC t-statistic, top-minus-bottom
quantile spread (bps/day), and daily rank turnover without exposing internal equations
or issuing a local promotion verdict. Pro tool (1 credit on hosted).

bars.description: Optional caller-supplied OHLCV rows [{symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume}].
bars.title: Bars

formula.description: Caller-supplied symbolic expression using causal operators (CS_ZScore, CS_Rank, CS_Winsorize, TS_Mean, TS_Std, TS_Delta, TS_Corr, KaufmanER, Ret, Abs, Sign) and variables (ret1d, ret5d, ret20d, close, volume, vol_ratio), e.g. 'CS_ZScore(TS_Mean(ret1d, 10) * KaufmanER(10))'.
formula.title: Formula

forward_horizon_days.description: Forward return horizon in trading sessions (1-20).
forward_horizon_days.title: Forward Horizon Days

symbols.description: Optional list of tickers (min 2) via the shared cache/relay.
symbols.title: Symbols
